field.title: title
mode.ask.short: asks before every edit and command

mode.auto.short: works alone, sandboxed; asks for anything beyond
mode.auto.summary: edits, installs, builds and tests on its own, sandboxed in its worktree; asks before anything beyond — network, pushes, your accounts
